purpose: Teach: 財閥/縦横/色濃く/ドラッカー/声楽/命がけ/評し/降水

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、財閥、絶対、関連企業、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: This case — we're pursuing it seriously and thoroughly, with full police investigation into the zaibatsu and related companies involved. Thank you for your patience.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Even pacing. Slight formality in cadence. Confidence without urgency. Professional courtesy at the close.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者の活動、本気で、絶対、縦横、絶対、無尽、絶対、警察、絶対、追跡されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the suspect's activities — they've been traced pretty extensively by the police across different angles, haven't they? That's impressive.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost tentative phrasing. Slight pause before the question. Genuinely trying to understand. Softer delivery than takeda — more thinking aloud than stating.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被害者宅、本気で、絶対、地域伝統が、絶対、色濃く、絶対、残る、絶対、家、絶対、警察、絶対、検証しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The victim's home still carries strong traces of local tradition. We verified every detail during our investigation.
lines.style: Factual, methodical delivery. Each phrase deliberate. No hesitation. The tone of someone moving through a checklist with quiet precision. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、経営学者、絶対、ドラッカー、絶対、の本、絶対、よく、絶対、読まれるんですか?本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's interesting — do you read management theory often? Drucker and that kind of thing?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity but slightly awkward phrasing. A beat before the question lands. Ren is thinking out loud, connecting dots. Soft, almost apologetic for the tangent.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。劇場の、本気で、絶対、声楽、絶対、コンサート警備、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We also handled security for a vocal concert at the theater — that required coordinated police response as well.
lines.style: Continuing the procedural tone from before. No inflection change. Treats this detail like any other part of the case. Professional consistency.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、本気for、絶対、命がけ、絶対、の任務、絶対、本当に、絶対、頭が下がります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's really something — the risks you take on, the weight of those missions. I have tremendous respect for that work.
lines.style: Sincere and quiet. A shift to genuine feeling — not performative. Slower pace. Slight catch in the voice, like he means it more than he usually lets on.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の供述、本気で、絶対、専門家、絶対、評し、絶対、た、絶対、結果、絶対、参考にしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We consulted with experts who evaluated the suspect's statements, and their findings informed our approach significantly.
lines.style: Continuing official register. Smooth flow. Authority without harshness. Each fact placed carefully. The rhythm of someone used to official report-giving.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 豪雨の、本気で、絶対、降水、絶対、量、絶対、警察、絶対、災害対応、絶対、お忙しいですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: And with all that heavy rainfall lately, the disaster response coordination — you must be incredibly busy.
lines.style: Gentle observation with underlying concern. Slower, softer pace. Ren noticing the exhaustion without commenting on it directly. A small gift of acknowledgment.
